text:
Alex: FYI merged #8242 a minute ago — integration pipeline went red. integration-smoke failed on model-serve-smoke with an allocation error, saw 502s on the runner. anyone able to grab?
CI Bot: Build #8242 - integration-smoke — FAILED on job model-serve-smoke (exit code 137). Logs: `RuntimeError: device alloc failed` Link: https://ci.redwood.example/builds/8242 :warning:
Mina: paging infra @SRE Oncall — is this isolated to the dedicated pool or happening on canary too? :eyes:
Jamie: I reproduced locally, looks like GPU alloc OOM during kv-store init. Grep shows `kv_alloc: cannot reserve shard 3`. @Alex did your PR touch kvcache init?
Alex: PR only touched routing + a small guard in kvcache init, not allocation size. If it's my change I'll revert. Can someone paste the exact failing command from the container?
SRE Oncall: grabbing logs now. also check node label — these ran on `gpu-type:a100-40g`. Can you paste the failing container cmd?
Alex: snippet from logs: `python -m serve.run --model gpt-small --batch 1 --seq 1024` then `RuntimeError: device alloc failed: driver error 11`
Mina: try a rerun with smaller seq/batch? If the guard bumped prefix usage it could push us over. Jamie, can you run local smoke with `SEQ=512` and `SEQ=1024`?
Jamie: running quick checks. will report back in ~5m.
CI Bot: Rerun requested by Mina. Job queued...
Alex: canary was fine earlier — this only tripped integration after the merge.
Jamie: local: SEQ=512 passes, SEQ=1024 fails consistently. looks like memory pressure changed. @SRE Oncall can we temporarily set integration-smoke seq to 512 so merges don't block while we triage?
SRE Oncall: I can patch the pipeline job config to seq=512. applying patch now.
SRE Oncall: patch applied, kicking rerun for the merge commit.
CI Bot: Rerun started...
CI Bot: Rerun finished — PASS.
Mina: ok nice. Alex please open a follow-up to track root cause (kvcache allocation math or guard side-effect) and add a dedicated test for SEQ=1024 on a larger runner. tag eng-runtime + eng-infra.
Alex: will open a PR to revert the init guard for now and follow up with a proper fix + test.
Jamie: thanks team. :thumbsup:
notes: This thread is a short triage: merge triggered integration pipeline failure due to GPU alloc OOM at sequence length 1024. Temporary mitigation was reducing seq to 512 for integration-smoke; root cause follow-up tracked in a separate PR.
